name: Inter Protocol
summary: Community-governed protocol that issued IST through Agoric smart contracts before completing a 2025 sunset.
notes: Keep Inter Protocol separate from Agoric OpCo, the Decentralized Cooperation Foundation, and the Economic Committee.

name: Agoric
summary: Blockchain and technology ecosystem on which Inter Protocol and IST operated.
notes: Technology and network role only; not treated as a simple legal issuer of IST.

name: Decentral Bank
summary: DAO that launched, operated, changed, and wound down the NEAR-native USN stablecoin.
notes: Keep Decentral Bank separate from NEAR Foundation, Aurora Labs, and White Knight Protection.
